metadata.title: Distributor Network | PT Autentik Karya Analitika
metadata.description: Information on group distribution channels, distributors, and subdistributors for PT Autentik Karya Analitika products, coordinated through MIKA.

hero.title: Find information about AKA product distribution
hero.description: AKA acts as the manufacturer. MIKA coordinates purchasing enquiries and helps identify suitable distributors or subdistributors.

group.title: Marketing and distribution within the group ecosystem
group.description: Group distribution channels are presented using information managed and verified by AKA.

cta.title: Need a distributor in your region?
cta.description: Tell MIKA about your requirements and region. MIKA will help identify the appropriate distributor or subdistributor channel.
cta.whatsapp: Hello MIKA, I would like information about AKA product distributors or subdistributors for my region and requirements.
